summary: Interactive picker for the AI analysts that shows one analyst's wording of the same facts at a time.
purpose: Lets visitors compare analyst voices for the same verified facts.
why: The product idea is one set of facts with different styles, and every voice is labelled as AI.
how: Steps in order: it receives a list of voices and a label. It starts on the first voice. It shows a group of radio buttons, one per analyst. When the user picks an analyst, the box shows that analyst's sentences with the AI analyst label and a source footer.
inputs: A list of voices, each with an analyst key, a name, and sentences, plus a label text.
outputs: The voice box and the chosen analyst.
risks: An empty voice list makes the component fail at once. The source footer is fixed text. The colour of each analyst comes from a variable named after it, so a missing variable gives a default colour.
debug: If nothing shows, check that the voice list is not empty. If the wrong source name shows, check the footer text. If colours are missing, check the variables named after each analyst.
